bands.label: Strong
bands.blurb: Solid contracts, transparent operations, and an easy start.

providers.name: Crescendo Lab
providers.description: Crescendo Lab is a Taiwan-based, Asia-leading AI omnichannel customer communication software company (cresclab.com) serving 800+ global brands, and a LINE Biz-Solutions Gold Partner. Its platform spans MAAC (AI marketing automation), CAAC (conversational applications), and DAAC (data intelligence) across LINE, WhatsApp, SMS, email, and social channels. Its developer-facing surface is MAAC Go (sms.cresclab.com) — a self-serve, NCC-compliant Taiwan SMS API with a published OpenAPI spec, first-party Node/Python SDKs, a CLI, an official MCP server, and delivery webhooks. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

bands.label: Developing
bands.blurb: Real signal across most facets with visible, nameable gaps.

providers.name: Autopass
providers.description: Autopass ("快速通") is a Taiwan-based mobility financial-services platform that connects service locations, car-owner apps, payments and benefits so that every driver enjoys a fast, convenient driving experience. Through its "powered by Autopass" service-authorization program, channel brand partners embed license-plate-based parking payment into their own car-owner apps: they register user license plates, surface partner parking locations (POIs) with live rates and hours, read in-progress parking sessions and completed orders, and receive entry/exit/billing/refund notifications over an OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect secured API. Autopass aims to become Asia's largest provider of mobility financial services. Backed by 500 Global.

bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: National Tsing Hua University
providers.description: National Tsing Hua University (NTHU) is a national public research university in Hsinchu, Taiwan, originally founded in 1911 and re-established in Taiwan in 1956. It is ranked #210 in the QS World University Rankings 2025 and is one of Taiwan's premier research institutions across science, engineering, humanities, and management. NTHU does not operate an official institution-wide developer portal, but its public developer footprint centers on the community-maintained NTHU Data API (NTHU-SA), a live FastAPI/OpenAPI service that aggregates public campus data such as courses, buses, dining, library spaces, announcements, and energy usage. Related open-source work lives across student and lab GitHub organizations.

providers.name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
providers.description: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) is a public research university in Taiwan formed in 2021 from the merger of National Yang-Ming University and National Chiao Tung University, and ranked #219 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public developer footprint centers on an OAuth 2.0 / single sign-on identity service (id.nycu.edu.tw) for third-party application integration, and the NYCU Dataverse research-data repository which exposes standard Dataverse REST APIs (Native and Search) and an OAI-PMH metadata-harvesting endpoint. Most administrative, course, and portal systems are gated behind institutional SSO rather than openly documented.

providers.name: TG3D Studio
providers.description: TG3D Studio Inc. is a 3D fashion technology company (founded 2016, headquartered in Taiwan) whose Scanatic platform digitizes the body, materials, and clothing for made-to-measure and custom fashion. Its products include the Scanatic 360 Body Scanner (roughly 250 body measurements captured in seconds), Scanatic Studio 3D product-visualization and digital-sampling software, the Cloudzet mobile body-scan app, and the BESPOKE-N virtual try-on app. For developers and partners, TG3D exposes two RESTful API libraries: ScanAPI — offered free to partners for integrating Cloudzet scan-user registration and building custom UI that controls the Scanatic 360 Body Scanner — and APIConnect, which manipulates data across the Scanatic Body, Nuno3D, and StyleBook services. API access is key-based and issued from the Scanatic for Fashion Developer Console; all HTTPS traffic is 256-bit encrypted and each Scanatic Body Service includes up to 1,500 free API requests per month.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: hotcake 夯客
providers.description: HOTCAKE 夯客 (Hotcake Inc. / 夯客股份有限公司) is a Taipei, Taiwan SaaS platform for the beauty and wellness industry — hair salons, nail and lash studios, skincare and medical beauty clinics, massage and fitness. It gives merchants an intuitive appointment, membership, and POS system covering 24-hour automated online booking, member passports and tagging, stored-value and voucher/loyalty programs, checkout and revenue analytics, inventory management, staff scheduling, and marketing automation. HOTCAKE is a LINE official-account technical partner and integrates LINE Pay, third-party payment gateways, and Google Calendar/Maps. It is delivered as a subscription with no long-term contract and same-day go-live. HOTCAKE was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it ships mobile merchant apps and a merchant documentation/help manual, but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK.

providers.name: National Cheng Kung University
providers.description: National Cheng Kung University (NCKU) is a public research university based in Tainan, Taiwan, ranked #215 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public, machine-readable footprint centers on a CKAN-powered open data platform that exposes the standard CKAN Action API, an Ex Libris Primo/Alma library discovery layer, and a DSpace 7 institutional repository. NCKU does not operate a single consolidated developer portal; the cataloged interfaces below are platform-standard APIs confirmed live rather than bespoke, documented university APIs.

providers.name: OEN
providers.description: Oen (應援科技) is a Taiwan-based fintech company operating an integrated payments and CRM cloud platform. It provides multi-channel payment processing (credit cards, convenience-store payments, bank transfers, and subscriptions), electronic invoicing, and a supporter-relationship CRM covering event and ticketing management, member and volunteer management, merchandise/reward redemption, and email/SMS communications. The platform serves nonprofits, political organizations, educational institutions, entertainment events, and commercial merchants, with more than 600 organizations and individuals using Oen. The company runs an API Gateway and mobile-payment surface, a public responsible-disclosure and bug-bounty program, and displays PCI DSS Level 1, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 trust badges.

providers.name: Sciket
providers.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: ProLogium Technology
providers.description: ProLogium Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese energy-innovation company founded in 2006 that develops and manufactures next-generation solid-state lithium ceramic batteries built around a 100% ceramic separator. It commercialized its first solid-state cells in 2013, opened the world's first giga-level solid-state lithium ceramic battery plant in Taoyuan, Taiwan in 2024, and operates a European R&D center at Paris-Saclay with a planned gigafactory in Dunkirk, France. Its product lines span FLCB, PLCB and LLCB cells plus battery modules and packs, targeting electric vehicles, energy storage systems, robotics, and consumer and industrial applications. ProLogium is a hardware manufacturer: it publishes no developer portal, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: TutorABC
providers.description: TutorABC (formerly iTutorGroup) is a Taiwan-headquartered online language-learning platform offering live one-on-one and small-group English and Chinese instruction to learners worldwide. Courses span conversational and business English, Mandarin Chinese, certification-exam prep, and study-abroad advising, delivered through a proprietary web and mobile classroom with matched tutors and partnerships with institutions such as Oxford and Cambridge. The company runs consumer learning sites alongside separate portals for tutor recruitment, learning consultants, and interviewer/onboarding workflows. TutorABC is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company identity, its agent-facing llms.txt, and its domain-security posture surfaced by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: PopChill
providers.description: PopChill is Taiwan's largest secondhand luxury fashion trading platform, operating as a mobile marketplace app for buying and selling authenticated pre-owned designer goods including handbags, watches, jewelry, apparel, and footwear from Chanel, Hermes, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Prada, and 40+ other brands. The company provides item authentication, secure transactions, and seller support to a consumer audience. PopChill is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or technical integration surface; this profile tracks the company in the API Evangelist network pending any future API program.

providers.name: Fox-Tech
providers.description: FOX-TECH CO. is a New Taipei City, Taiwan IoT company (founded 2016, backed by 500 Global and SparkLabs Taipei) that digitally transforms farming, logistics, cold-chain, and manufacturing operations. Its TempHawk platform pairs wireless temperature, humidity, CO2, light-intensity and soil-EC sensors over Sigfox LPWAN with web and mobile apps and cloud data analytics, helping the perishable-goods value chain monitor conditions, manage risk, and meet policy compliance. Recognized on the Forward Fooding FoodTech 500. No public API, developer portal, or SDK is currently published.

providers.name: Bounty Hunter
providers.description: Bounty Hunter (獎金獵人) is Taiwan's largest creative-competition platform, founded in 2011 to help young creators discover and enter contests. It aggregates and curates design, illustration, photography, short-film, writing, music, business-planning, programming, and academic competitions from Taiwan and around the world for its several-hundred-thousand registered creator members. Through its Contest Builder (contest.bhuntr.com) and brand-services arm (desk.bhuntr.com) it also runs sponsored competitions for clients including Google, Microsoft, Lexus, McDonald's, and E.SUN. The company established a U.S. headquarters in 2014 and is backed by 500 Startups (500 Global) and Silicon Valley angel investors. It exposes no documented public developer API; api.bhuntr.com is an undocumented first-party backend.

providers.name: Mutto Optronics
providers.description: Mutto Optronics (Mutto Inc) is a Taipei, Taiwan-based provider of resistive and capacitive touch panels for the mobile phone and tablet market. Formerly a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio company, it is now publicly held. It is a hardware/optronics manufacturer with no public API, developer program, or documented software surface. The registered domain (muttoinc.com) has lapsed and now resolves to a domain-parking and ad-monetization landing page across all hosts, so there is no first-party developer, docs, or API infrastructure to enrich.

providers.name: TryTry (穿穿)
providers.description: TryTry (穿穿, trytrytw.com) was a Taiwanese women's fashion e-commerce brand ("是妳，決定了這件衣服的表情" — "It's you who decides the expression of this dress"), active around 2015-2016 and surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company. The business appears defunct — as of 2026-07-21 trytrytw.com is domain-squatted (wildcard DNS to a parked Chinese web-design page, serving an expired TLS certificate issued for an unrelated host) and no developer, API, or documentation surface exists.

providers.name: WeGrow asia CO., LTD.
providers.description: WeGrow asia CO., LTD. (威果) is a Taiwan-based agricultural technology company operating a franchise model for modern, technology-driven farming. It pairs 24-hour AI-assisted remote crop management with a transparent farmer profit-sharing model, specializing in high-value strawberries and cantaloupes while handling production, labor management, marketing, and logistics end to end ("you provide the land, we provide the labor and expertise"). WeGrow surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a bilingual (TW/EN) marketing website only and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface — every probed developer and well-known path returned HTTP 404.

providers.name: ypxfood
providers.description: ypxfood (YPX Cayman) is a Taiwanese quick-service restaurant company specializing in Taiwanese food and snacks, backed by Qiming Venture Partners, LionRock Capital, and Ignition Capital. It is a consumer restaurant and food business with no public developer or API surface; enrichment probes found the corporate website (Cloudflare-fronted, returning 403 to automated clients) and no documentation, OpenAPI, SDKs, or well-known discovery endpoints. This profile is retained as a network company record.

providers.name: XING Mobility
providers.description: XING Mobility (行競科技) is a Taiwan-based battery technology company building immersion-cooled lithium battery systems under the IMMERSIO brand, including cell-to-pack (CTP) battery platforms, battery backup units (BBU) for AI data centers, and the automotive-grade XBE energy storage series, serving electric mobility, energy storage (ESS), marine, and data center markets from its Taoyuan City headquarters. A 500 Global portfolio company, XING Mobility publishes no public developer API or API documentation as of July 2026.

providers.name: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics
providers.description: Elixiron Immunotherapeutics (Cayman) Limited is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017, with offices in Taipei, Taiwan and Cambridge, Massachusetts, developing precision immunotherapies for neuroinflammation, autoimmune disease and cancer. Its clinical pipeline is led by enrupatinib (EI-1071), a small-molecule CSF-1R inhibitor in development for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative indications, and EI-001, a fully human anti-interferon-gamma monoclonal antibody in Phase 2 for vitiligo, alongside preclinical EI-012 (anti-CD36) and EI-220 (mRNA) oncology programs. The company publishes a corporate and investor-relations website only: there is no developer portal, public API, SDK, webhook surface or machine-readable specification of any kind on its own hosts.

providers.name: Tripplus
providers.description: TripPlus (點數旅遊) is a Taiwan-based travel-rewards and loyalty-points platform. It provides airline mileage award-ticket search and redemption tools, curated recommendations and comparisons of US travel credit cards, and a marketplace for buying and selling airline miles and reward points. The consumer-facing site (tripplus.cc) is fronted by Cloudflare and, as of this enrichment pass, exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or documented well-known endpoints. Backed by 500 Global; tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: National Taiwan University
providers.description: National Taiwan University is a higher-education institution in Taiwan. This profile is a STUB: it records the institution's identity only. No claim is made about its programmable surface -- what it operates, what a vendor operates on its behalf, and what it publishes have not yet been established. Run the university pipeline (all/0-working/pipeline-university.md) to profile it.
